lines.en: : I take it we both fell asleep?
: Is there a {i}reason{/i} for this silence? Or...
lines.zh: : 这么沉默是{i}有原因{/i}的吧？还是说……

lines.en: : What do you mean “something happened?” Did that weird picture-wall go down?
lines.zh: : “出事了”是什么意思？那堵奇怪的画面墙塌了？

lines.en: : I think you should...probably go see for yourself...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你大概该……自己去看一眼……

lines.en: : The sky is back to normal.
: All the stuff I brought up here is...well, it's still {i}here.{/i} And I didn’t see anyone when I went downstairs to use the restroom.
lines.zh: : 我搬上来的那些东西……嗯，它们还{i}在{/i}。而且我下楼去上厕所的时候，一个人也没看见。

lines.en: : No one’s answering their phone either. And I’ve tried everyone.
lines.zh: : 也没有人接电话。我每个人都打过了。

lines.en: : This...hasn’t ever happened before, has it? Where...the world resets but...no one {i}else{/i} goes with it?
lines.zh: : 这种事……以前从没发生过，对吧？就是……世界重置了，可{i}别人{/i}都没跟着一起回来？

lines.en: : Do you want to, like...look around or something? Maybe today is just a holiday and...and all the girls are grouped up somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 你想不想，比方说……到处看看什么的？也许今天只是个节假日……所有的姑娘都聚在别的地方？

lines.en: : Or...or maybe it would be safer to stay put? Maybe the reset’s only, like...halfway done? Maybe we just need to wait out the rest?
lines.zh: : 或者……或者也许待在原地更安全？也许重置只完成了，比方说……一半？也许我们只需要等剩下的那一半？

lines.en: : What if this isn’t a reset?
: Maybe it’s a whole new world entirely. Maybe we really {i}did{/i} live through the apocalypse. I don’t fucking know. It doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 也许这是一个全新的世界。也许我们{i}真的{/i}熬过了世界末日。我他妈的不知道。这说不通。

lines.en: : Well...well if...that wall is gone...we can go out and look for Maya, right? Even if it’s a risk. Maybe she’ll know what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，如果……那堵墙没了……我们就能出去找 Maya 了，对吧？哪怕有风险。也许她会知道发生了什么？

lines.en: : Or maybe she’s gone and we’re the only people left? Maybe we’ve got a whole fucking world to ourselves now and everything else is fucked?
lines.zh: : 也许她已经不在了，只剩我们两个？也许现在我们他妈的拥有了一整个世界，而其他一切都完蛋了？

lines.en: : Or maybe not? Maybe there’s still a chance to...you know...fix things?
lines.zh: : 也许不是呢？也许还有机会去……你知道的……把事情修好？

lines.en: : It’s good to see you managed to find your optimism again. It just kind of sucks that it took a botched reset in order to bring it back. It would have been really helpful last night.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你又找回乐观了。只不过有点可惜，要靠一次搞砸的重置才能把它唤回来。要是昨晚就有，会很有帮助的。

lines.en: : I know...I’m not upset. I’d probably be lashing out even more if I was in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我没生气。我要是处在你的位置，大概会闹得更凶。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} in my shoes. It’s not like I’m the only person impacted by everyone and everything suddenly vanishing.
lines.zh: : 你{i}就{/i}处在我的位置。突然消失的可不只有我一个人受影响，也不只我一个人受影响。

lines.en: : No...but I know how badly you wanted to see Maya again. And all I did last night was-
lines.zh: : 是没错……可我知道你有多想再见 Maya 一面。而我昨晚做的只有——

lines.en: : Maya’s still here. We just have to find her. And once we do, the world will fix itself.
lines.zh: : Maya 还在这儿。我们只要找到她就行。等找到了，世界就会自己修好。

lines.en: : She’s clearly necessary for the reset to work properly if {i}this{/i} is what we get when she’s not here.
lines.zh: : 既然她不在的时候我们就得到了{i}这种{/i}结果，那她显然是重置正常运作所必需的。

lines.en: : Which one is it? Is everyone and everything gone? Or are we going to try and keep hope alive by saying Maya is somehow exempt from all of that?
lines.zh: : 到底是哪个？是所有人、所有东西都没了？还是我们要靠“Maya  somehow 不受影响”这种说法来维持希望？

lines.en: : I’ll give you an answer when I think of one. For now, we need to get off of this roof and...do {i}something.{/i} Anything.
lines.zh: : 等我想到答案了再告诉你。眼下，我们得离开这个屋顶，去做点{i}什么{/i}。什么都行。

lines.en: : But if we can’t find anyone...and it really is just us left...what then?
lines.zh: : 可是如果我们找不到任何人……真的只剩我们两个了……那怎么办？

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} have an answer to that question? Because I sure as hell don’t.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}对这个问题有答案吗？反正我是他妈的没有。

lines.en: : Then...I guess that’s just a bridge we’ll have to cross if we ever get to it.
lines.zh: : 那……我想那座桥，等真走到再说吧。

lines.en: : I really hope we don’t, Ayane...
: This is kind of creepy, isn’t it?

: It’s one thing to wander the halls of the school while the sky is eating itself and the moon is growing larger by the second, but there’s something even {i}more{/i} unsettling about being alone here in the light.
lines.zh: : 在天空自我吞噬、月亮一秒比一秒大的时候逛学校走廊是一回事，可在光天化日之下独自待在这里，却有某种{i}更{/i}让人不安的东西。

lines.en: : I think you’re just used to the former already. And you’ll have plenty of time to get used to this as well if we really are alone.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只是已经习惯前者了。要是我们真的落单了，你也有大把时间去习惯这种。

lines.en: : On the bright side, at least we’ll be able to have sex in all of the classrooms without getting in trouble.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少我们能在所有教室里做爱，还不会被抓。

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about sex right now, Ayane.
: That’s how you know it’s bad.
lines.zh: : 由此可知，情况有多糟了。

lines.en: : But I doubt it’s going to get any better if we just stare outside the window waiting for something to happen.
lines.zh: : 不过光盯着窗外等事情发生，我看情况也不会好转。

lines.en: : It...feels kind of weird leaving after being stuck here for over a month. Surreal, even.
lines.zh: : 被困在这儿一个多月之后要离开，感觉……有点怪。甚至有点超现实。

lines.en: : More surreal than a sky made up of pictures and making coffee on an old school desk?
lines.zh: : 比由画面构成的天空、还有在旧课桌上煮咖啡更超现实？

lines.en: : When that’s what you’ve gotten used to, yeah. Going back to normal {i}is{/i} surreal after spending so much time in a world that doesn’t even seem possible.
lines.zh: : 当后者成了你已经习惯的东西，是啊。在一个看起来根本不可能存在的世界里待了那么久之后，回到“正常”{i}反倒{/i}成了超现实。

lines.en: : This is anything but normal and you know that.
lines.zh: : 这跟正常一点都不沾边，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : I’m not sure I {i}know{/i} anything anymore. It’s like any time I manage to pull myself out of {i}one{/i} crisis, another takes its place.
lines.zh: : 我不确定自己现在还{i}知道{/i}什么。就好像我每次刚从{i}一场{/i}危机里爬出来，另一场就顶了上来。

lines.en: : Maybe Maya’s been wrong this whole time and {i}I’m{/i} the most unlucky girl to ever exist?
lines.zh: : 也许 Maya 从头到尾都错了，{i}我{/i}才是世上最倒霉的女孩？

lines.en: : You can tell her that when you see her later and I’m sure she’ll have some sort of witty counterpoint to make you eat your words.
lines.zh: : 你等下见到她可以这么说，我保证她会有某种机智的反驳，让你把话咽回去。

lines.en: : I just keep thinking about the last thing I said to her.
lines.zh: : 我一直在想，我对她说的最后一句话是什么。

lines.en: : Something mean. But it made sense in the moment.
lines.zh: : 很过分的话。不过在当时那情境下说得通。

lines.en: : Do you remember the last thing {i}you{/i} said to her?
lines.zh: : 你记得{i}你{/i}对她说的最后一句话吗？

lines.en: : So, what’ll be the first stop on Sensei & Ayane’s post-apocalyptic field-trip through Kumon-mi {i}this{/i} time?
lines.zh: : 那么，{i}这次{/i} Sensei 和 Ayane 的末日 Kumon-mi 郊游，第一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : The dorms. That’s where we found her the last time she vanished, and I’m willing to bet it’s where we’ll find her again this time.
lines.zh: : 宿舍。上次她失踪的时候，我们就是在那儿找到她的，我敢打赌这次也会在那儿找到她。

lines.en: : Would you mind if we stopped at a few other places first?
lines.zh: : 我们先在别的地方停几站，你介意吗？

lines.en: : Anywhere people might gather. The park....Koi Cafe...things like that. Nothing too far.
lines.zh: : 任何人们可能会聚集的地方。公园……Koi Cafe……之类的。别太远就行。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t hurt, I don’t think. And if there {i}is{/i} anyone left, I imagine they’d group up somewhere, like...public. Somewhere that everyone visits regularly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得也没什么坏处。而且如果{i}真的{/i}还有人在，我想他们会聚在某个……比方说公共场所。一个大家都常去的地方。

lines.en: : For all we know, they might not have been able to {i}get{/i} to the school. That wall could have boxed the two of us in while everyone else wondered where {i}we{/i} went.
lines.zh: : 说不定他们根本没法{i}到{/i}学校来。那堵墙也许把我们两个困在了里面，而其他人正在纳闷{i}我们{/i}去哪儿了。

lines.en: : Literally everything about this is highly improbable. But if you really don’t think it’s a good idea, we can-
lines.zh: : 这事从头到尾就没一样是可能的。不过你要是真觉得不妥，我们可以——

lines.en: : Like you said, it won’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : And finding {i}anyone{/i} would, at the bare minimum, help us get a better idea of what might be going on here. Especially if they’ve been...{i}conscious{/i} anywhere near as long as you have.
lines.zh: : 而且找到{i}任何{/i}人，至少能帮我们更好地搞清楚这里到底发生了什么。尤其是如果他们……{i}清醒{/i}的时间跟你差不多长的话。

lines.en: : Thank you for not abusing your power as someone who may very well be the last man on earth while the last {i}girl{/i} on earth is much smaller and weaker than you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你没有滥用你的权力——毕竟你很可能是地球上最后一个男人，而地球上最后一个{i}女孩{/i}又比你矮小虚弱得多。

lines.en: : Smaller, yes. Weaker? Doubtful. You know karate.
lines.zh: : 矮小，是的。虚弱？未必。你可是会空手道的。

lines.en: : I’ll teach you everything I know if we’re unable to find anyone. And you’ll have plenty of time to learn since you don’t want to impregnate me and repopulate the world.
lines.zh: : 要是找不到人，我把我会的全教给你。反正你又不想让我怀孕、重新繁衍人类，你有的是时间学。

lines.en: : Let’s just...focus on finding someone first, Ayane. {i}Then{/i} we can talk about repopulating.
lines.zh: : 我们还是……先专心找人吧，Ayane。{i}然后{/i}再谈繁衍的事。

lines.en: There is no one at the park.
There is no one on the street we take to school.
lines.zh: 我们上学走的那条街上一个人也没有。

lines.en: And there is no one at Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: Koi Cafe 里也一个人也没有。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m willing to admit my idea was a bust now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。现在我愿意承认我的主意泡汤了。

lines.en: : I had a feeling it would be.
: Thank you for humoring me regardless. I just...
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你迁就我。我只是……

lines.en: : I really had a feeling like we’d find someone here. And after you managed to track down Maya the first time, I wanted to be of some use {i}this{/i} time and-
lines.zh: : 我真的有种感觉，觉得我们会在这儿找到什么人。而且上次你成功找到了 Maya，{i}这次{/i}我也想派上点用场——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Let’s just get to the dorms. We’ve used up enough time getting partially sidetracked like this.
lines.zh: : 没事。我们直接去宿舍吧。像这样被岔开，已经浪费够多时间了。

lines.en: : Are you {i}really{/i} sure that’s where you want to go next, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你{i}真的{/i}确定下一站要去那儿吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I mentioned it in the very beginning of our “field trip.” Why does it sound like you’re about to try and talk me out of it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我在这场“郊游”一开始就是这么说的。怎么听起来你像是打算劝我别去？

lines.en: : Well...you remember last night...when we were talking about, like...voices and stuff?
lines.zh: : 就是……你还记得昨晚……我们聊的那个，比方说……声音之类的事吗？

lines.en: : It’s faint, and...I’m not really sure if I’d even call it a {i}voice,{/i} but...
lines.zh: : 很模糊，而且……我也不确定能不能把它叫做{i}声音{/i}，不过……

lines.en: : It’s like something in the back of mind is telling me we shouldn’t go there yet.
lines.zh: : 就像我脑子深处有什么东西在告诉我，我们还不该去那儿。

lines.en: : Weren’t you {i}just{/i} telling me last night that those “voices” don’t need to be taken as gospel? We’re not obligated to listen to them. And I’m not willing to risk waiting around any longer.
lines.zh: : 你{i}昨晚{/i}不是刚跟我说过，那些“声音”不必当福音来听吗？我们没有义务听它们的。而且我不想再冒险干等下去了。

lines.en: : Oh, I just want to get this rock out of my boot before...got it. Okay, we’re good.
lines.zh: : 哦，我只是想把我靴子里的石头弄出来再……好了。行，我们可以走了。

lines.en: : Did I really need to be stopped for that?
lines.zh: : 这种事也真需要让我停下来？

lines.en: There is no one outside of the dorms.
lines.zh: 宿舍外面一个人也没有。

lines.en: There was no one outside of them the other time she vanished either and we still managed to find her.
lines.zh: 上次她失踪的时候，外面也一样一个人都没有，我们最后还是找到她了。

lines.en: And I’ll find her again, no matter how many places I need to search.
lines.zh: 而我会再找到她一次，不管要搜多少个地方。

lines.en: : Don’t try and talk me out of going inside, Ayane.
: I won’t...and I’ll be right there with you.
lines.zh: : 我不会……而且我会陪着你。

lines.en: : I just...I don’t want to see you lose hope if she isn’t there. And I feel like you will.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不想看到你因为她不在就失去希望。而我觉得你会。

lines.en: : But I feel like you will.
There is no one in the dorms.
: There’s no one in the dorms.
: She’s not here because I killed her in Paper City.
lines.zh: : 她不在这儿，因为我在纸城里杀了她。

lines.en: : See? I knew this was going to happen.
: Yes, but there are still places we can look.
lines.zh: : 是的，不过还有别的地方可以找。

lines.en: : There’s no one in the dorms.
: I am calm. I’m calm as can be. I’m the calmest I’ve ever been. I’m calm. I’m so calm. I’m calm, Ayane. I am.
lines.zh: : 我很冷静。我冷静得不能再冷静了。我从没这么冷静过。我很冷静。我冷静极了。我很冷静，Ayane。我真的很冷静。

lines.en: : No, you’re not. And I get that you’ve been doing your best to keep it together ever since you woke up, but you need to do {i}better.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，你不冷静。我知道你从醒过来就一直在努力撑着，可你需要做得{i}更好{/i}。

lines.en: : Fight? Fight what? What the fuck do you want me to do? Am I not allowed to freak out for a second while I come to terms with the fact that I might never see Maya again?
lines.zh: : 战斗？跟什么战斗？你他妈的到底想让我做什么？难道在我接受自己可能再也见不到 Maya 这件事的时候，连慌一下都不行吗？

lines.en: : You’re not allowed to freak out at all.
: You have to stay completely calm and {i}fight{/i} because, if you don’t, you won’t ever get out of this.
lines.zh: : 你必须保持绝对的冷静，然后{i}战斗{/i}，因为如果你做不到，你就永远走不出这一切。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you mean?! How do you know that?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的是什么意思？！你怎么知道的？！

lines.en: : I know it because you haven’t even made it out of the house yet.
lines.zh: : 我知道，是因为你连那栋房子都还没走出去。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t have opened the door.
: Fuck! Right there! Right there, baby!
lines.zh: : 操！就是那儿！就是那儿，宝贝！

lines.en: : Ohhh my god! I’m gonna cum...you’re gonna make me cum!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦我的天！我要去了……你要让我去了！

lines.en: : You like my pussy, baby?...You like...fucking me like that?...Yeah?...
lines.zh: : 你喜欢我的屄吗，宝贝？……你喜欢……那样操我吗？……嗯？……
: 断片性爱…………{i}果然{/i}是最棒的…………

lines.en: : Look who.....finally decided to show up...
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧是谁…………终于决定出现了…………

lines.en: : I repeat......{i}don’t you dare fucking stop...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我再说一遍…………{i}你他妈的敢停试试……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}God{/i} that feels so good. Holy shit.

lines.zh: : 我{i}完了……{/i}不管是字面还是比喻意义上……

lines.en: : What does that mean?! What’s going to happen to you?!
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？！你会怎么样？！

lines.en: : Probably the...same thing that happened to you all those...times I couldn’t hold myself back...
lines.zh: : 大概跟……你那些次我没能忍住的时候……发生的一样……

lines.en: : First...I’m going to cum {i}so fucking hard...{/i}
lines.zh: : 首先……我要{i}他妈的高潮到不行……{/i}

lines.en: : That’s it...there’s no third step after that...
lines.zh: : 就这样……在那之后没有第三步了……

lines.en: : That’s {i}worse{/i} than me being reset! How am I supposed to do any of this without you?!
lines.zh: : 那比我被重置还{i}糟{/i}！没有你，我怎么做得成这些事？！
: 你会想出办法的……你很聪明……

lines.en: : No I'm not! Not even close!
: I’ll get your memories back...I swear. I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 我会把你的记忆找回来……我发誓。我会做到的。

lines.en: : Good fucking luck. It took me a zillion years to get any of {i}yours{/i} back and we probably won’t even get to cuddle after this...
lines.zh: : 祝你他妈的好运。光是找回{i}你的{/i}一点点记忆，就花了我无数年，而且这事完了我们大概连抱都没法抱一下……

lines.en: : How do you know?! How do you know it’ll be you instead of me?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道？！你怎么知道会是你而不是我？！

lines.en: : If it weren’t for the...costume you tore off of me...I wouldn’t even know what day it is right now...
lines.zh: : 如果不是因为……你从我身上撕下来的那套戏服……我甚至都不知道今天是哪一天……

lines.en: : Give it a...fucking break, would you?...Just screw me and...let my mind get wiped on a slightly happier note...
lines.zh: : 你他妈的给我……消停点行不行？……就操我，让我的记忆……在一个稍微开心点的调子上被抹掉吧……

lines.en: Her legs wrap around my waist and push me in deeper, but despite my mind’s desperate pleas to put an end to this, my body refuses to let up.
lines.zh: 她的双腿缠上我的腰，把我推得更深，可尽管我的脑子拼命求着这一切停下来，我的身体却不肯罢休。

lines.en: I press her hands harder into the concrete of the same rooftop where she changed my life and force my eyes shut so I can pretend this isn’t happening.
lines.zh: 我把她的手更用力地按在水泥地上——就是她改变了我人生的那个屋顶——然后强迫自己闭上眼睛，假装这一切没有发生。

lines.en: : Open your eyes...pervert...you know you...can’t resist me...
lines.zh: : 睁开眼……变态……你明明……抵抗不了我……

lines.en: They don’t stay closed for long, though.
: God I...almost forgot...how big you are...that’s so good...that’s so fucking good...
lines.zh: : 天哪我……差点忘了……你有多大……好舒服……太他妈的舒服了……

lines.en: : Why do you get to close your eyes but not me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么你能闭眼，我却不行？……

lines.en: : If you want to play that game...I won’t take my eyes off of you again until this is all over...
